section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 26 Means Adopted to commit suicides : A study of suicide cases according to the 'Means Adopted' for committing suicides revealed that the majority of persons committed suicides by taking poison and 23.5 percent of the total suicides were committed by this method during 1980. The other important 'Means Used' for committing suicides were 'Hanging' (23.1%), 'Drowning' (17.3%), 'Fire' (7.4%), 'Railways' (6.4%). 'Jumping', (1.3%), 'Fire-arms' (1.2%), 'Weapons' (0.8%) and 'Machine' (0.6%) while 18.4 percent of the total suicides registered during 1980 was shared by the suicides grouped under 'Other Means'. The details are presented in Table-IV.
